paragraphs: StackMap sells indoor mapping software for libraries, described on its own pages as a unified platform of indoor mapping tools shaped to a library community's needs. The Collection Mapping product connects to a library catalog, discovery and mobile search to provide a map and written directions to any item. Explore puts a library's physical space and resources on a kiosk, mobile device, or web browser.

Room Mapping shows where study rooms, lecture halls, conference spaces, and offices sit in a facility, with custom integrations offered for an existing room reservation system, event calendar, library website, and mobile app. Computer Availability Mapping shows which computers are available in real-time, and the computer maps can be embedded on digital displays and the library's website. Library staff can update the layout when items move, through a process designed to match existing workflows and limit overhead.
StackMap describes its market as running from community public libraries to research and national institutions around the world. Librarians make up over half of the team, according to the about page.

quote.text: Our unified platform of indoor mapping tools creates a custom StackMap experience for your library community’s specific needs.
